title: Clean AI Engineering: principles, specification formats and gates for building AI agents as testable software
description: The umbrella of a family of open specifications for AI agents: the principles, the Spec Charter that routes each statement to the right specification, the Baseline of software practice cited rather than restated, the draft per-agent specification format (AOAS), and the four gates (behaviour, features, structure, harness) with the cycle that routes every failure back to a specification. It joins the AI Assurance Catalog (what must be true), the AI Harness Catalog (what must exist) and AgentTwin (what an agent must face).
